dataset: autoPET / FDG-PET-CT-Lesions (TCIA), via NCI Imaging Data Commons
citation: Gatidis S et al. A whole-body FDG-PET/CT dataset with manually annotated tumor lesions. Sci Data 2022;9:601. doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01718-3
patient: female, 75 years; CT 1 mm slices every 0.7 mm, 0.86 mm pixels, IV contrast (removed)
frame: mm; +x patient left, +y anterior, +z inferior; origin midway between femoral head centres

position.operated: right hip extended, patella up, 15 deg internal rotation
position.well: left thigh lifted out of the beam (removed beyond a rounded stump below the left hip)

measured.method: neck axis vs posterior condylar line, viewed along head centre -> knee centre

fracture.type: AO/OTA 31-A1 two-part pertrochanteric (lateral wall intact, lesser trochanter on the shaft)

volume.labels: lab: 0 static, 128 proximal (head-neck) fragment, 255 distal (shaft) fragment; linear in between
volume.layout: x-fastest uint8 planes; first plane byte-delta along x. fine/mid: excess, lab. coarse: base
